notebook.name: lint
notebook.title: Check the notebook's health
notebook.description: Check this notebook's health from a snapshot for this call. Omit rule for counts and previews of the applicable rules; limit and cursor require rule. Set rule to read its items, then continue with next_cursor; pages may move between calls. count_capped marks a lower bound, not the end of pagination. target_cut marks a shortened display target, not its full identity; use item_key. Page and source items include their full paths.

rule.description: An exact health check rule. Omit for counts and previews; limit and cursor require a rule.

limit.description: At most this many items, 1 to 100. Default 50.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous answer, to continue after its last item.

notebook.name: pending_sources
notebook.title: List undigested sources
notebook.description: List an LLM Wiki's undigested sources from a snapshot for this call. LLM Wiki only: a standard notebook is refused. This is the undigested_sources health check, with each source's path, kind, bytes and original created_at; empty source pages are omitted. Continue with next_cursor; pages may move between calls. Each item keeps its complete item_key and cursor.

limit.description: At most this many items, 1 to 100. Default 50.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous answer, to continue after its last item.
